title: Sabrina's Project Team
story: Sabrina works as a project coordinator at a software company in Dhaka. Her team, managed by Hasan, is building a shopping app for a supermarket chain. She works closely with Imran, a developer, and Lamia, a designer, while Nabila is their contact on the client side.
storyBn: সাবরিনা ঢাকার একটি সফটওয়্যার কোম্পানিতে প্রজেক্ট কো-অর্ডিনেটর হিসেবে কাজ করে। হাসানের নেতৃত্বে তার দল একটি সুপারশপ চেইনের জন্য শপিং অ্যাপ বানাচ্ছে। সে ডেভেলপার ইমরান ও ডিজাইনার লামিয়ার সাথে কাজ করে, আর ক্লায়েন্টের পক্ষে যোগাযোগ রাখেন নাবিলা।

units.focus: Report progress and recent work on the project
units.focusBn: প্রকল্পের অগ্রগতি ও সাম্প্রতিক কাজের খবর দেওয়া

sessions.tipBn: সাম্প্রতিক খবর বা অতীতে শুরু হয়ে এখনও প্রাসঙ্গিক কাজ বোঝাতে have/has + past participle হয়।

items.en: Sabrina has just sent the weekly update to the client.
Imran has already fixed the login bug on the app.
Lamia has redesigned the home screen twice since Monday.
We have finished two out of five project milestones.
Hasan has managed this team since the project started last year.
I have booked the large meeting room for Thursday's demo.

words.bn: আগে থেকে ঠিক করেছি, বুক করেছি

sessions.pattern: Subject + haven't/hasn't + past participle (+ yet). / has never + past participle
sessions.tipBn: না-বোধক করতে haven't বা hasn't বসে; yet সাধারণত বাক্যের শেষে থাকে।

items.en: The client hasn't replied to Sabrina's email yet.
Imran hasn't tested the payment page on older phones.
We haven't received the final content from the marketing team.
Lamia has never presented her designs to a client before.
I haven't had time to read the full report.
Nobody has updated the project calendar since last Monday.

sessions.tipBn: প্রশ্ন করতে Have বা Has শুরুতে বসে; ever দিয়ে অভিজ্ঞতা, yet দিয়ে কাজ শেষ হয়েছে কিনা জানা যায়।

items.en: Has the client replied to the weekly update yet?
Have you ever worked with an international client?
Has Imran shared the latest version of the app with the testers?
Have we booked a room for Thursday's demo?
Has Hasan approved the new timeline for the second phase?
Have you had a chance to look at my slides?

sessions.tipBn: প্রথমে Wh-word, তারপর have/has, subject ও past participle বসে।

items.en: What have you finished since this morning?
How long has Lamia been at the company?
Why hasn't the client signed the contract yet?
Which features have we completed this week?
Who has taken the projector from the meeting room?
How many bugs have the testers found so far?

sessions.pattern: A short update written mostly in the present perfect.
sessions.tipBn: অগ্রগতির খবর দিতে present perfect বেশি ব্যবহার হয়: কী হয়ে গেছে, কী এখনও হয়নি।

items.title: Weekly status update
items.en: Hi team, here is a quick update on the app. Imran has fixed the login bug, and Lamia has finished the new home screen. We haven't received the final content from the client yet, so I have sent them a reminder. Hasan has already approved the timeline for phase two.

items.title: Reply to the client
items.en: Dear Nabila, thank you for your patience. We have completed the payment feature, and our testers have checked it on ten different phones. We haven't found any serious problems so far. I have attached a short video that shows how the feature works.

items.title: A new team member
items.en: Hi everyone, please welcome Tanha, our new tester. She has worked in software testing for four years and has joined us from a company in Chattogram. I have already given her access to the project files. Please say hello when you see her at the desk near the window.

units.focus: Describe what was happening during busy moments at work
units.focusBn: অফিসের ব্যস্ত মুহূর্তে কী ঘটছিল তা বর্ণনা করা

sessions.tipBn: অতীতের কোনো সময়ে চলমান কাজ বোঝাতে was/were + verb-ing হয়; when বা while দিয়ে দুটি ঘটনা যুক্ত হয়।

items.en: Sabrina was presenting the demo when the projector suddenly stopped.
Imran was fixing a bug while the rest of the team was having lunch.
At ten o'clock yesterday, we were discussing the budget with the client.
Lamia was working from home when the power went out.
Hasan was talking to the client when I knocked on his door.
The whole team was waiting for the test results all afternoon.

sessions.tipBn: না-বোধক করতে was বা were-এর পরে not বসে, তারপর verb-ing।

items.en: Sabrina wasn't expecting so many questions from the client.
Imran wasn't listening when Hasan explained the new deadline.
We weren't using the latest version of the file.
Lamia wasn't feeling well, so she left the office early.
The Wi-Fi wasn't working during the morning meeting.
I wasn't checking my phone, so I missed your call.

sessions.tipBn: প্রশ্ন করতে Was বা Were শুরুতে বসে, তারপর subject ও verb-ing।

items.en: Were you taking notes during the client meeting?
Was Imran still working when you left last night?
Was the client joining from their office or from home?
Were the testers using the old version of the app?
Was Hasan sharing his screen when the call dropped?
Were you and Lamia talking about the new design?

sessions.tipBn: প্রথমে Wh-word, তারপর was/were, subject ও verb-ing বসে।

items.en: What were you working on when the system crashed?
Why was Imran staying so late at the office?
Who was sitting at my desk this morning?
Where were you going in such a hurry?
What was the client complaining about during the call?
How were you feeling before your first presentation?

sessions.pattern: A short account of past events, mostly in the past continuous.
sessions.tipBn: পটভূমিতে চলমান কাজ past continuous-এ, আর হঠাৎ ঘটা ঘটনা past simple-এ লেখা হয়।

items.title: What happened during the demo
items.en: Yesterday afternoon, Sabrina was presenting the new app to the client. While she was showing the payment screen, the projector suddenly stopped working. Imran was sitting near the door, so he quickly brought a spare laptop. Meanwhile, Lamia was answering the client's questions about the design.

items.title: Sorry for the late reply
items.en: Hi Hasan, sorry for the late reply. I was working on the report this morning when the power went out in our area. My laptop battery was running low, and the internet wasn't working either. I will finish the report as soon as the power comes back.

items.title: Monday meeting summary
items.en: In Monday's meeting, while we were reviewing the timeline, the client asked for two new features. Hasan was taking notes, and Imran was checking how much time each feature needs. At the end, we were still discussing the budget, so we agreed to meet again on Wednesday.

units.focus: Give advice, rules and polite requests at work
units.focusBn: অফিসে পরামর্শ, নিয়ম ও ভদ্র অনুরোধ জানানো

sessions.tipBn: should পরামর্শ, must ও have to বাধ্যবাধকতা, might সম্ভাবনা, আর could প্রস্তাব বা সম্ভাবনা বোঝায়।

items.en: You should back up your files before you leave every evening.
All visitors must sign in at the front desk.
We have to submit the final design by Thursday.
The client might ask for more changes after the demo.
You could ask IT to reset your password.
Lamia needs to update the slides before the meeting.

sessions.pattern: Subject + shouldn't/mustn't/don't have to/might not/can't + verb (base) ...
sessions.tipBn: mustn't মানে করা নিষেধ, কিন্তু don't have to মানে করার দরকার নেই।

items.en: You shouldn't reply to the client without checking with Hasan first.
We mustn't share client data outside the company.
You don't have to come in early tomorrow.
The client might not like the new colors.
I can't join the call at three because I have another meeting.
Lamia doesn't need to print the slides for the meeting.

sessions.pattern: Should/Can/Could + subject + verb (base) ...? / Do/Does + subject + have to/need to + verb ...?
sessions.tipBn: modal দিয়ে প্রশ্ন করতে modal শুরুতে বসে; have to বা need to হলে শুরুতে Do বা Does লাগে।

items.en: Should I copy Hasan on my reply to the client?
Could you share your screen for a moment?
Do we have to finish the testing by Wednesday?
Can I leave an hour early today?
Does everyone need to attend the training on Thursday?
Could the delay affect the launch date?

sessions.pattern: Statement with a modal, + opposite short tag?
sessions.tipBn: হ্যাঁ-বোধক বাক্যের পরে না-বোধক ট্যাগ, আর না-বোধক বাক্যের পরে হ্যাঁ-বোধক ট্যাগ বসে।

items.en: We should tell the client about the delay, shouldn't we?
You can join the meeting at ten, can't you?
Imran has to finish the bug fixes today, doesn't he?
We don't have to wear formal clothes on Thursdays, do we?
Lamia shouldn't work this late every night, should she?
I can take my annual leave in December, can't I?

sessions.pattern: A short workplace message with rules, advice or requests.
sessions.tipBn: নিয়ম, পরামর্শ ও অনুরোধ লিখতে must, should, have to, could, might একসাথে ব্যবহার হয়।

items.title: Office rules for new staff
items.en: Welcome to the team! You must wear your ID card at all times in the building. You should lock your computer when you leave your desk, even for a few minutes. You don't have to come in on weekends, but you might need to join an urgent call sometimes.

items.title: Message to the team
items.en: Hi team, the client has moved the demo to Tuesday, so we need to work fast. Imran, could you finish the payment fixes by Sunday evening? Lamia should update the slides with the new screens. We might have to stay a little late on Monday, but I will order dinner for everyone.

items.title: Asking for a day off
items.en: Dear Hasan, I would like to ask for a day off next Wednesday. My sister is getting married, and I have to travel to Sylhet. I can finish my tasks before I leave, and Imran could cover any urgent issues. Please let me know if that works for you.

units.focus: Talk about possible and imagined situations at work
units.focusBn: অফিসের সম্ভাব্য ও কাল্পনিক পরিস্থিতি নিয়ে বলা

sessions.pattern: If + present, will + verb. / If + past, would + verb.
sessions.tipBn: সম্ভাব্য অবস্থার জন্য If + present ও will, আর কাল্পনিক অবস্থার জন্য If + past ও would ব্যবহার হয়।

items.en: If the client approves the design today, we will start coding tomorrow.
If you send me the file, I'll check it after lunch.
If I were the manager, I would give everyone Thursday afternoons off.
If we had more developers, we would finish the project much faster.
If the internet goes down again, we'll use the mobile hotspot.
If Lamia got an offer from abroad, she would probably take it.

sessions.pattern: If + don't/doesn't ..., won't + verb. / If + didn't ..., wouldn't + verb.
sessions.tipBn: শর্তবাক্যে না-বোধক অর্থ দিতে don't, won't, didn't বা wouldn't ব্যবহার হয়।

items.en: If we don't get the content by Sunday, we won't meet the deadline.
If Imran doesn't fix this bug, the app won't pass the test.
I wouldn't accept the offer if the salary were lower.
If I didn't have this deadline, I wouldn't work on the weekend.
The client won't be happy if we miss the launch date.
If you don't lock your screen, someone might read your emails.

sessions.tipBn: Wh-প্রশ্নের পরে will বা would বসে, আর শর্তটি If দিয়ে যুক্ত হয়।

items.en: What will you do if the client rejects the design?
Who will lead the team if Hasan goes on leave?
How would you feel if you had to work every weekend?
What would you change if you were the team leader?
Where will we meet if the conference room is busy?
Which task would you choose if you could work on anything?

sessions.pattern: A short text with first and second conditional sentences.
sessions.tipBn: বাস্তব পরিকল্পনার জন্য If + present ও will, আর কল্পনার জন্য If + past ও would লেখা হয়।

items.title: Plan B for the launch
items.en: Hi all, the launch is still planned for the 15th. If the testers find no major bugs this week, we will release the app on time. If they find serious problems, we will move the launch by one week. I will send you an update on Thursday.

items.title: If I were the manager
items.en: Imran often jokes about being the boss. If he were the manager, he would start every day at ten o'clock. He would also cancel half of the meetings and give the team more time to write code. But he says that if he had Hasan's job, he would probably miss coding.

items.title: New work-from-home plan
items.en: Hi team, here is our new work-from-home plan. If your tasks for the week are clear, you can work from home on Thursdays. If you work from home, you must stay online from ten to five and answer messages quickly. If the plan works well, we will add a second day next year.
